youtube.script: Can your AI read files safely? OpenAI said it trained GPT-Red, an internal red-teaming model, and used it to harden GPT-5.6 against prompt injection. That matters when an AI can browse, open files, or act through connected tools, because the safest habit is still a human checkpoint before anything sensitive happens. So if your system can send a payment, post publicly, or share private data, treat that step as approval-only. If you use connected AI tools, where would you add the checkpoint first: payments or publishing? Leave it in the comments, and I can cover the checklist next.
